notes: The robed teacher under the Miners' Bridge (story bible §3.5, §5.17; mw-ju8.14): Idris Quillon (npc-quillon), a scholar the Lantern Court struck off the register, teaches Ember, the first step of the Fire school's chain (ADR-0004), for 200 crowns, inside the economy doc's trainer band (100-400). He is only there between dusk and dawn (the counter and the creature carry presence {dusk, night} in the under-the-bridge scene). He sells no goods and holds no till. Favours instead of crowns wait on the favour system.
